subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt or recreate the open fork PR for this cron stagger bug, or close that PR and allow a new same-repo repair?
rationale: The bug remains in current main and the latest release, but the linked implementation candidate is an open cross-repo fork PR with maintainer edits disabled, so automation should not start another fix without a maintainer choosing the path.

options.title: Adopt or recreate the fix
options.body: Review the open fork PR's approach and, if maintainer-editability blocks landing, recreate the same narrow fix in a maintainer-owned branch with the required tests.

options.title: Land the fork PR directly
options.body: Use the existing contributor branch if maintainers are comfortable with the fork workflow and its proof/CI state can be brought up to the repository bar.

options.title: Close the fork PR first
options.body: Close the linked fork PR only if maintainers reject its approach or want a fresh same-repo implementation to own the remaining work.

recommendation.title: Adopt or recreate the fix
recommendation.body: Review the open fork PR's approach and, if maintainer-editability blocks landing, recreate the same narrow fix in a maintainer-owned branch with the required tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the default cron stagger helper and service integration that define the affected behavior.
